questions.skill: Write and solve linear equations with rational coefficients for real-world problems
questions.prompt: Gym A charges $30 to join plus $12.50 per month. Gym B charges $55 to join plus $10 per month. Write and solve an equation to find when the total costs are equal.
questions.prompt_markup:
Gym A charges $30 to join plus $12.50 per month. Gym B charges $55 to join plus $10 per month.
Write and solve an equation to find when the total costs are equal.
questions.correct_answer: The equation 30 + 12.5m = 55 + 10m and the answer m = 10 months
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid equation (or system) and the correct solution. Any valid model is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.

sections.skill: Create equations and inequalities in one variable to solve problems

questions.skill: Create equations and inequalities in one variable to solve problems
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 10 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: Plan A costs $25 plus $0.15 per text. Plan B costs $40 with unlimited texts. Write and solve an inequality to find when Plan A costs less.
questions.prompt_markup:
Plan A costs $25 plus $0.15 per text. Plan B costs $40 with unlimited texts.
Write and solve an inequality to find when Plan A costs less.
questions.correct_answer: The inequality 25 + 0.15t < 40 and the answer t < 100 texts (0 to 99 texts)
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid inequality and the correct solution. Any valid model is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.

questions.prompt: Two trains leave a station at the same time in opposite directions, at 55 and 65 miles per hour. Write and solve an equation to find when they are 300 miles apart.
questions.prompt_markup:

Write and solve an equation to find when they are 300 miles apart.
questions.correct_answer: The equation 55t + 65t = 300 and the answer t = 2.5 hours
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid equation (or system) and the correct solution. Any valid model is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.
